resources.title: Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM)
resources.description: Ultra-high resolution field emission SEM capable of 1.0 nm resolution at 15 kV. Ideal for imaging nanomaterials, biological specimens, and semiconductor thin films.
resources.safety_instructions: Must wear cleanroom garments. No ferromagnetic or wet samples allowed without prior dehydration approval.
resources.booking_rules: Book at least 24 hours in advance. Maximum 2 active slots per researcher per week.

resources.title: Bio-Rad C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler (PCR)
resources.description: Thermal cycler with dual 48-well fast reaction modules and optical gradient reaction system for DNA/RNA amplification and genetic analysis.
resources.safety_instructions: Wear nitrile gloves and lab coat at all times. Dispose of tubes in biohazard bins.
resources.booking_rules: Free for enrolled university STEM researchers. Clean module upon completion.

resources.title: Atomic Force Microscope (Park NX10 AFM)
resources.description: High-precision nanoscale surface profiler for atomic-level topography, magnetic force microscopy, and electrical conductivity mapping with true non-contact mode.
resources.safety_instructions: Acoustic isolation hood must be closed during measurements. Calibrate cantilever resonance before contact engagement.
resources.booking_rules: Samples must be dry and mounted securely on 12mm magnetic pucks. Maximum 3 bookings per week.

resources.title: Cleanroom Photolithography & Mask Aligner Station
resources.description: Sub-micron UV contact mask aligner with automated spin coater and precision hotplates for microfluidic device fabrication and wafer patterning.
resources.safety_instructions: Full cleanroom gowning (bunny suit, hood, booties, nitrile gloves) required at all times. Yellow room light only.
resources.booking_rules: Clean exposure chuck with IPA after each session. Dispose of resist pipettes in hazardous waste container.

resources.title: Confocal Laser Scanning Microscope (Leica Stellaris 5)
resources.description: Spectral confocal imaging system equipped with White Light Laser (440-790 nm) and sensitive HyD detectors for multi-channel live-cell fluorescence and 3D optical sectioning.
resources.safety_instructions: Laser safety interlocks must never be bypassed. Biosafety Level 1 and 2 certified samples only.
resources.booking_rules: Clean oil-immersion lenses immediately using lens paper and spectrophotometric-grade cleaner.

resources.title: X-Ray Powder Diffractometer (XRD - Bruker D8 Advance)
resources.description: High-throughput powder X-ray diffractometer with Cu-Ka source and LynxEye detector for crystal phase identification, crystallite size determination, and thin film stress analysis.
resources.safety_instructions: Check radiation safety shutter indicator light before opening enclosure. Wear campus radiation dosimeter badge.
resources.booking_rules: Samples must be finely ground (<10 microns) and packed flush in zero-background sample holders.

resources.title: Materials Characterization Collaboration Lab (Lab 205)
resources.description: Multi-disciplinary analytical workstation room with dual-monitor data processing terminals, OriginPro, MATLAB, and ImageJ licenses, whiteboard walls, and presentation screen.
resources.safety_instructions: Keep workstation terminals tidy. Do not disconnect network or display cables.
resources.booking_rules: Free for university research groups and lab seminar meetings. Leave dry-erase boards clean.

resources.title: Smart Seminar Auditorium B
resources.description: Acoustically treated tiered lecture hall with 85-person seating, laser projection, wireless lapel microphones, and live lecture recording.
resources.safety_instructions: Only authorized personnel may adjust AV amplifier rack.
resources.booking_rules: Must be reserved at least 3 business days in advance.

eligibility_requirements.description: Cleanroom entry clearance and chemical hygiene plan authorization.
